records.claim: Gabapentin may lower folic acid levels in some people who take this medication. Some healthcare organizations recommend taking a higher dose of folic acid for people taking certain medications, while others do not. Talk with your healthcare provider about the amount of folic acid that is right for you. For more information, see the MotherToBaby fact sheet at https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/folic-acid/.
records.source_section: Does taking gabapentin increase the chance of birth defects?
